signals.text: 22 insider-transaction filings were made for Nvidia between 1 Aug and 6 Nov.
Nvidia's independent directors retained an outside investigator.
Nvidia's chief executive resigned with immediate effect.
Microsoft filed an 8-K reporting a director or senior officer change (item 5.02).
UK travel advice added Ebola screening or entry-check notices for Cote d'Ivoire (9 Nov), Liberia (11 Nov) and Madagascar (11 Nov).
UK travel advice for Poland added information following a terrorist attack in Krakow.
UK travel advice for Georgia added new details on the political situation.
The UK now advises against all but essential travel to Moyale Town, Kenya, and the area within 5 km, including the Ethiopian border.
UK travel advice for the USA updated its details on flight disruptions across the country.
Six EASA conflict-zone bulletins (Iran, Iraq, Lebanon, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman) are valid only until 16 Nov and are due for renewal or withdrawal.
The US Maritime Administration issued advisory 2026-014, worldwide, on foreign adversarial technological, physical and cyber influence.
The Bank of Japan published a decision changing the pace of its ETF sales.
China's official manufacturing PMI fell below 50 in October (49.3, from 50.1).
